fields.name: task
fields.note: The SimOps task or question. Can be a mode name ('price_bom', 'cascade', 'optimise', 'predict', 'narrate', 'scout_sidstreams') or a natural language request about the active process.

fields.name: process_context
fields.note: Optional. The active process configuration: process_name, stage_id, current_observations. If omitted, the companion reads from workspace state.

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.note: Optional. Target SimOps workspace ID. Resolved from context if absent.
